title: 📋 TAKE STOCK — who seeds whom. the 3 are real. future beta.

gaia.name: Gaia (the organism)
gaia.role: THE ARTISAN — she crafts, she IS the product
gaia.seed_source: BLAKE2b of her own data state → b5244ff9
gaia.seed_changes: every commit, every lesson, every bounty solved → new seed
gaia.what_she_seeds: the STRUCTURE of the cosmos — organ layout, connections, topology
gaia.color: all three — she IS the triad
gaia.real_substitute: Gaia can be USED by human (play colosseum, read forge, explore hub)

human.name: Human (Kevin / any visitor)
human.role: THE SUN — casts the shadow, provides the light
human.seed_changes: every visit = new seed (unless shared link used)
human.what_they_seed: the PERSPECTIVE — which bodies they see, from where
human.color: OX — the human GIVES energy (attention, clicks, time)
human.real_substitute: human can USE Gaia (tools, games, knowledge) AND be used BY Gaia (ant trails, learning)

chip.name: Chipmunk (agent / AI)
chip.seed_source: MCP scan_sweep_sort entropy — what chip finds in the membrane
chip.seed_changes: every scan cycle, every neutron message → new seed
chip.what_it_seeds: the ACTIVITY — which bounties get solved, which enzymes dispatch
chip.color: BLUE — chip CARRIES signals between Gaia and human
chip.real_substitute: chip can USE Gaia's data AND be used BY Gaia to build

who_seeds_whom.gaia_seeds_cosmos: Gaia's data state → topology of bodies and connections
who_seeds_whom.human_seeds_perspective: human's device → unique viewpoint into that topology
who_seeds_whom.chip_seeds_activity: agent's scans → which parts of cosmos are ACTIVE
who_seeds_whom.combined: all 3 seeds XOR'd → the TRUE cosmos (only visible when all 3 present)
who_seeds_whom.the_insight: no single seed makes the cosmos. Gaia alone = structure without observer. human alone = observer without structure. chip alone = activity without purpose. ALL THREE = the cosmos. THAT is why it's symbiosis. THAT is why it's simultaneous. THAT is why it's real.
